title: Make the fake host keep the promises QMUX keeps

cases.says: each request gets the scripted answer in order, a silent step gives null, and after the script every request is approved
the listener form hands an answered request's response to responseReceived with the hand-back
a request the host left unanswered is still recorded as sent, so a test can tell a resend from a single attempt
the response is a new message and the client's request is left unchanged, as with QMUX
the response MTI is derived from the request's: an 0100 is answered by an 0110 and an 0420 by an 0430
with no answer the listener form calls expired once and never passes null to responseReceived
the response echoes the request's fields, as a host's answer does, besides adding field 39
